mode.description: solo: agent twin only; paired: agent twin plus a human.

human.description: GitHub login of the paired human.

page.description: Where to page this seat (overrides [notify] target).

seats.description: Seat modes keyed by seat slug (registry seats).

base_url.description: Gateway endpoint including the version path, e.g. https://gateway.example/v1; empty disables the gateway.

secret.description: Name of the secret holding the gateway key (sent as Authorization: Bearer).

api_style.description: Wire format for every model without a styles entry: messages (Anthropic Messages), responses (OpenAI Responses), chat (OpenAI Chat Completions). Empty uses the family default.

styles.description: Wire format overrides as "<model-id or family>=<style>", e.g. "grok-4.7=chat" (model IDs contain dots, so this is a list, not a table).

model.description: Model ID as the provider or gateway names it.

family.description: Model family; inferred from the model ID when empty.

additionalProperties.description: [models.<lane>.<host>]: lane and host IDs from the verb registry.

models.description: Model overrides per lane and host, and the optional AI gateway.

quota_warn_percent.description: doctor warns when LFS storage or bandwidth use reaches this percentage.

media.description: Optional private bucket that keeps proof media beyond the merge gate's run artifact (aayu ship copies them there), and holds design and UI baseline media on a public repo (V3): s3://bucket[/prefix][?region=..&endpoint=..], r2://<account>/bucket[/prefix], azblob://<account>/<container>[/prefix][?auth=sas|key|oidc|cli&tenant=..&client=..&subscription=..&group=..], or gs://<bucket>[/prefix][?auth=key|oidc|cli&provider=..&sa=..].

media_secret.description: Name of the secret holding the bucket's credential (ACCESS_KEY_ID:SECRET_ACCESS_KEY for s3 and r2; a SAS token or <client-id>:<client-secret> for azblob; a service account JSON key for gs; none with auth oidc or cli); empty means proof-media.

retention_days.description: Days the merge gate keeps its aayudha-pack run artifact, at most the repository's artifact retention limit; also the bucket's lifecycle rule. 0 keeps as long as the limit allows.

beneficiaries.description: Beneficiary groups a Goal can name, keyed by slug, with a one-line description.

streak.description: Correction-free merges per layer footprint before agent lanes may self-ship.

approver.description: GitHub login that approves when autonomy does not apply.

correction_days.description: Days after a merge in which a linked Bug or Incident counts as a correction of the PR.

proof.description: Merge a PR into the integration branch on proof alone: required checks green, the pack verified with its floors holding, inspect at merge with a proof_rungs rung, and nothing in the narrow set.

proof_rungs.description: Review rungs at the head (A, B, C) that let ship merge on proof.

always_person.description: The narrow set: paths (a trailing / for a directory, else a glob) whose change always needs a person per PR.

always_person_config.description: TOML config files whose always_person_sections need a person when they change.

always_person_sections.description: Config tables (by first key) that decide who may approve or bypass.

authority.description: Decision type or layer to the seat or login that may accept it.

sla_hours.description: Business hours before an open Decision pages its authority and escalates.

provisional_after_hours.description: Business hours before a reversible Decision's recommendation applies provisionally (V8).

solo_provisional_after_hours.description: In solo mode (at most one human), the shorter window before a reversible Decision's recommendation applies provisionally (V8); at least 12, and read only from .aayudha/config.toml.

escalate_to.description: GitHub login mentioned on escalation (founder B).

target.description: slack: name of the secret holding the webhook URL; email: recipient address; github: login to mention; file: path of the JSON-lines outbox (default .aayudha/state/notify-outbox.jsonl), which the Actions loops keep as an artifact.

issue.description: github channel: issue the mention comment is posted on, as owner/name#number.

smtp_addr.description: email channel: SMTP server as host:port (STARTTLS).

from.description: email channel: sender address, also the SMTP user.

smtp_secret.description: email channel: name of the secret holding the SMTP password.

per_pr_inspect_max.description: Model spend in USD for inspect on one PR across all its cycles.

secret.description: Name of the secret holding the key (WP1.3); never the key itself.

url.description: Provider base URL when not the adapter's default (EU region, self-hosted), e.g. https://eu.posthog.com.

org.description: Provider organization: the Sentry organization slug, or the Microsoft Entra tenant ID (azure).

project.description: Provider project: the PostHog project ID, the Sentry project ID, the owner/name GitHub baselines read (default: the current repository), the Azure resource ID of the Log Analytics workspace or Application Insights component (azure), the CloudWatch RUM app monitor name (aws), or <project>.<dataset> of the GA4 BigQuery export (gcp).

allow_pii.description: posthog, sentry: let an agent call the host MCP tools that return personal data (person records, replay content, raw LLM prompts, support tickets). Off by default (Decision #449).

transport.description: Figma only: rest (personal access token, the default) or mcp (the remote MCP server, opt-in; the secret is an OAuth access token).

auth.description: azure, aws, gcp: key (a credential in the secret, the default), oidc (GitHub Actions OIDC federation: short-lived tokens, no stored key), or cli (the az, aws, or gcloud login on this machine).

identity.description: azure, aws, gcp with auth = "oidc": the Entra application (client) ID, the IAM role ARN, or the service account email to impersonate (optional for gcp).

federation.description: gcp with auth = "oidc": the workload identity provider, projects/<number>/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/<pool>/providers/<provider>.

region.description: aws: the region of the app monitor and log group, e.g. eu-west-1; gcp: the BigQuery location when it is not US or EU.

integrations.description: External integrations keyed by name. Values name secrets; they never hold them.

platforms.description: Platforms the product ships on, e.g. web, ios, android.

upstream_checks.description: Existing product CI check names the merge gate also requires.

seed.description: Command (argv) that loads seeded, synthetic data into the app before the web floors capture (WP4.5); the product provides it, e.g. under .aayudha/seed/.

url.description: Base URL of the running app.

production.description: A production environment: verify refuses to capture it (exit 4), and any target on its host.

environments.description: Apps the web, DAST, and API floors run against, by name; AAYU_ENV picks one (default local). A production environment is never captured.

command.description: Test command that writes the coverage report, as argv; empty runs go test -coverprofile in a Go module.

report.description: Coverage report the command writes (lcov, Cobertura XML, or Go coverprofile), relative to the repository root.

perf.description: Lighthouse budgets on every Completion Goal state (WP4.5).

script.description: k6 script whose thresholds are the API and CLI contract (WP4.6); BASE_URL is the target environment's URL. Empty skips the floor.

floors.description: Floor thresholds; CONSTRAINTS.md documents each one.

drift_blocking_from.description: Date (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD) from which feature-map drift fails the merge gate's feature-map floor; before it, or empty, drift is a warning.

red_on_base_blocking_from.description: Date (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD) from which a Bug story whose mapped proving test passes on the base commit fails the merge gate; before it, or empty, the red-on-base check is advisory.

maintainer.description: Agent app the feature maps' maintain brief @-mentions (WP4.5b.4): claude, codex, or cursor, installed on the repository; amp has no mention, so its scheduled loop thread reads the brief. Unset: the brief mentions no app.

tz.description: IANA time zone for business hours.

business_hours.description: Business days and hours, e.g. Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00.

app_id.description: GitHub App ID of the bot identity (created by init --identity).

app_slug.description: GitHub App slug; the App's login is <slug>[bot].

broker.description: Token broker workflow file in this repo that mints App installation tokens for laptops.

machine_user.description: Machine-user login, the fallback bot identity.

machine_user_secret.description: Name of the secret holding the machine user's token.

bot_logins.description: Logins whose reviews never count as a human pass (machine users and other bots).

device_client_id.description: Client ID (public) of the GitHub OAuth App or GitHub App, with Device Flow enabled, that a person approves human-only commands through from any device; unset, the repository variable AAYUDHA_DEVICE_CLIENT_ID or AAYUDHA_APP_CLIENT_ID.

identity.description: Bot identity for agent lanes and CI (WP1.4).

otlp_endpoint.description: Opt-in: also send traces as OTLP/HTTP JSON to this collector, e.g. https://collector.example:4318. Empty sends nothing.

telemetry.description: Traces of verb runs (WP1.8): a local file by default; nothing leaves the machine unless otlp_endpoint is set.

fleet.description: User-level only: the product repos that status --all and doctor --all iterate.

dev.description: Integration branch; pull requests target it.

rolling.description: Canary snapshot branch; empty when the product has none.

branches.description: The product's branches that play dev, rolling, and main when they have other names (written by init; nothing is renamed).

acquisition.description: Event that acquires a user (e.g. signed_up); empty means a user's first event in the window.

activation.description: Event that activates an acquired user within activation_days.

activation_days.description: Days after acquisition an activation counts; default 7.

retention.description: Event that counts as activity in days 7-13 after acquisition; empty means any event.

referral.description: Event by which an acquired user refers someone (e.g. invited_user).

north_star.description: North Star: an event (distinct users who sent it in the window) or revenue (paid total in the window).

measure.description: The events measure (WP7.2) reads as AARRR stages and the North Star.

tokens.description: Design-token source (tokens.json in the W3C design-tokens format) whose colours and type scale mockups and prototypes must use.

flags.description: OpenFeature flag definitions (flagd JSON) that must declare each prototype's flag, off by default.

design.description: Where the design verbs (WP6.5) find the design tokens and the OpenFeature flag definitions.

figma_diff_max.description: Largest share of pixels, in percent, a prototype screenshot may differ from its Figma frame after the anti-aliasing mask; colour and typography token mismatches must be zero regardless.

baseline.description: URL paths on the [verify.environments] target that baseline captures for each commit (WP6.6).

review.description: Tolerances of the prototype's Figma screenshot diff (WP6.5) and UI review (WP6.6).

stage.description: startup, scaleup, or enterprise. Unset: inferred from size (15 or fewer people startup, up to 150 scaleup, more enterprise).

size.description: People on the product team. Unset: the paired seat humans plus the founder.

team.description: The team the seat twins adapt their practice to (WP5.1b): depth and ceremony only, never the floors, the evidence rule, or human-only gates.

plain.description: Words only on a terminal: no colour, motion, emoji, or box drawing (screen-reader friendly); the same as --plain.

theme.description: Colour theme: auto (the terminal's own 16 colours, so a themed terminal's palette and its light or dark background apply; default), saffron (warm true colour for dark terminals), contrast (bright and bold), mono (no hue), or a named palette for a terminal that is not themed: nord, catppuccin-mocha, catppuccin-latte, gruvbox-dark, gruvbox-light, dracula, tokyonight, or solarized (dark or light by the terminal's background).

motion.description: Animate the full-screen inbox (loading, the next card, the selection, results); default true. false keeps it still. --plain, AAYU_PLAIN=1, [ui] plain, TERM=dumb, and NO_COLOR are always still.

ui.description: How aayu looks on a person's terminal (WP1.1b); usually set in the user-level config. Machines (--json, MCP, agents, CI, pipes) always get plain, stable text.

mode.description: general: one reviewer; peer: two reviewers of different families (both different from the builder's) cross-check each other's findings.

delegated_mode.description: Mode for a PR another agent built through build --delegate (WP5.5b).

min_confidence.description: P2 and P3 findings below this reviewer confidence are not posted; P0 and P1 always are.

suppress_after.description: A finding resembling this many distinct human dismissals in the same file or directory is not posted (never a P0 in security, data, or concurrency); 0 turns suppression off.

peer_model.description: Model ID of the peer reviewer; empty picks the first of the registry's review candidates whose family differs from the builder's and the first reviewer's.

generated.description: Path patterns (path.Match) of generated files that inspect does not review; the drift check owns them. Files whose header says Code generated ... DO NOT EDIT are skipped too.

reviewer.description: The one review tool of the merge gate. ci (the default): the merge gate calls the model the code-review environment names (variables AAYU_REVIEW_MODEL_URL and AAYU_REVIEW_MODEL, secret AAYU_REVIEW_MODEL_KEY) and fails closed until they are set; codex, coderabbit, greptile, claude, cursor: that installed app (a same-family app is a labelled rung-C review; CodeRabbit and Greptile count as rung A for any builder); human: a person; model: the review lane's model (aayudha's evals). When the chosen tool cannot review (a usage-limit or quota reply, or no reply within 30 minutes), the next installed app in the order codex, coderabbit, greptile, claude, cursor reviews, then ci, then a person.

apps.description: Agent apps installed on the repository's org or account that review pull requests: codex, coderabbit, greptile, claude, cursor. aayu doctor and aayu install detect them.

app_families.description: Model family of each reviewer app (anthropic, openai, google, xai). An app without one cannot review, since the different-family rule needs it; Cursor runs the model its user picks.

paid_reviewer.description: Rung B: the model ID (grok-4.7, gemini-3.8-flash, ...) the CI review calls when the code-review environment's AAYU_REVIEW_MODEL names none, and the fallback when no installed app can review the head. It must be of a family the builder cannot be; each PR's spend is capped by [budget] per_pr_inspect_max, and the review is labelled (B, paid).

paid_effort.description: Reasoning effort every review model call is made at (low, medium, high, xhigh); empty: high, and medium for Claude Opus, Claude Fable, and GPT-6 Astra. Every review asks for fast (priority) serving.

inspect.description: How inspect reviews a PR (WP4.8b): its mode, noise filters, and peer reviewer.

cursor_secret.description: Name of the secret holding the Cursor API key (aayu auth set-secret).

cursor_api.description: Base URL of Cursor's cloud agents API.

cursor_model.description: Model ID the Cursor cloud agent runs; empty: Cursor's default (its family is then unknown to aayu, so inspect names concrete reviewer families).

codex_env.description: ID of the Codex cloud environment whose Install script runs bash .agents/setup; empty: Codex runs only locally.

amp_orb_size.description: Orb size of a delegated Amp thread; empty: the Amp project's default.

claude_trigger.description: Unused since WP5.5c: Claude Code is reached through its own CLI's cloud sessions (claude --cloud), not claude-code-action, so no AI key sits in the repository's CI. Kept so 0.1 configurations still load.

checks.description: Commands the brief tells a receiver to run before it finishes; empty: the checks AGENTS.md lists.

local_timeout_minutes.description: Longest run of a receiver's CLI in an aayu worktree (--local).

delegate.description: How build --delegate reaches other agents (WP5.5b). Values name secrets; they never hold them.

plan.description: x (default): a Cursor plan from 12 October 2026 on, which includes only Cursor's own models, so the lanes default to Grok and Composer; legacy: a legacy Pro, Pro+, or Ultra plan, which includes Claude and Gemini. Read only from the user config, AAYU_HOSTS__CURSOR__PLAN, or --set, never from the checkout.

hosts.description: What the agent hosts include on the user's plan, which picks each lane's default model there (Decision #469).

approvers.description: GitHub logins of the people whose /aayu approve reply on a batch counts as their approval. Their GitHub credentials must be in no agent's reach (aayu doctor checks); with none, every batch needs the device code.

device_for.description: Batches that always need the device code, even when comment approvals are on: one-way (any irreversible item: an irreversible Decision, a floor waiver) or all.

approvals.description: Who approves agents' human-only steps by a comment, and which steps always need GitHub's device code (Decision #488).

title: aayudha config
description: Code generated by go generate (internal/verbs/gen) from internal/config; DO NOT EDIT. Layered: user, .aayudha/config.toml, .aayudha/config.local.toml, AAYU_<SECTION>__<KEY>, --set.
